scope: Follow-up adversarial audit requested after delivery

findings.fault: Cancelling an ASGI request released admission while its inference thread continued, allowing overlapping model executions.
findings.fix: The worker owns an independent execution lock through decode, inference and response validation; cancelled running and queued requests have regressions.

findings.fault: Pillow accepted malformed PNG chunks and some JPEGs missing their real end marker, contrary to the documented corrupt-image response.
findings.fix: Verify PNG structure and CRCs, and require a genuine JPEG end marker while correctly skipping embedded metadata and permitting trailing bytes.

findings.fault: Study finalization could not resume after partial publication because it recreated already-existing immutable files.
findings.fix: Reuse verified stage results and frozen decisions, pin release identity, preflight output collisions, and refuse incomplete holdout reuse without silently repeating evaluation.

findings.fault: Documentation generation required a historical benchmark file that a fresh study no longer produced.
findings.fix: Historical benchmarks are optional; release-bound benchmark identity remains mandatory.

findings.fault: Documentation could accept candidate checkpoint/run identities that contradicted the corresponding training-run record.
findings.fix: Cross-check run IDs and selected checkpoint digests before publishing generated conclusions.

findings.fault: Even a zero-step resume replaced original source/environment/pretrained provenance with the current execution and local cache.
findings.fix: Retain initial provenance in run records and checkpoints; append resume execution history; mark unrecoverable legacy origin unknown.

findings.fault: Very small normalized boxes could collapse during rounding or float32 conversion, escaping parsing and later breaking preparation or training.
findings.fix: Reject collapsed geometry during parsing so dataset preparation records an audited exclusion.

findings.fault: Metrics advertised a maximum of 100 detections per image but counted all candidates from supported larger-output bundles.
findings.fix: Validate all candidates, apply stable score-ranked top100 consistently across metrics and saved evaluation views, and report conditional cap exclusions.
